items.question: How long does it take to go live?
items.answer: Most teams are running within 2 to 6 weeks. If one of our existing agents fits your workflow out of the box, like RFP matching or sales query relay, you'll be live in about 2 weeks. If we need to tune the agents to your specific catalogue, SOPs, or systems, plan for 4 to 6 weeks.

items.question: How is our data kept safe?
items.answer: Your formulations, buyer lists, RFPs, and pricing are yours alone. LabGenie runs on AWS with isolated tenant environments, so no customer data ever touches another customer's models or queries. We never train shared models on your proprietary data. Access is role-based, every action is logged, and we sign NDAs and data processing agreements before onboarding begins.

items.question: Does it work with the tools we already use?
items.answer: Yes. LabGenie sits on top of what you already run. We integrate with SAP (S/4HANA and B1), Sage, Salesforce, Outlook, Teams, Slack, and the Excel sheets and shared drives your team lives in. If a data source matters to your decisions, we connect to it.

items.question: Can it handle our specific products and formulations?
items.answer: Yes. The agents learn your product catalogue, your SOPs, your spec formats, and your way of describing things. We start by ingesting what your team already references, and the agents get sharper with every interaction.

items.question: What if we only need one agent, not all three?
items.answer: Each agent works independently. Most customers start with one, usually the one solving their loudest pain, whether that's RFP matching, sales query routing, or compliance reporting. You expand when you see results. There's no requirement to deploy the full platform on day one.

items.question: How is LabGenie priced?
items.answer: We price on value created, not seats or usage. The starting point is a small percentage of the measurable value LabGenie generates, whether that's hours saved, RFPs won, reduced waste, or faster turnarounds. For new customers we run a three-month proof of concept at a fixed fee so we can measure the actual impact together, then move to value-based pricing once the numbers are real. No long lock-ins, no per-user surprises.
